sources.supports: Turned-out separated second-position feet, rounded overhead fifth-position arms, and the flat-foot knee/toe relationship in beginner plié. Specific shallow-phase and all-of image gates are project operational definitions.
The illustrated fifth-position arm variant has two curved arms above the head and separate fingertips. It is not a global numbering claim for all ballet schools.
Second position is illustrated with two separated, outward feet with both heels on the floor; first/fourth are distinct.

limits: The two seated variants are explicit project support-surface operationalizations of the existing reviewed seated/support primitives, not claims of a named photography standard.
General Plié and Port de bras remain unresolved broad labels; selected shallow flat-foot and rounded-overhead configurations are separate optional variants.
